full_judgment: 2. The petitioner in her FIR dated 5.2.1979 lodged through an officer of co-ordination and control cell for National Security alleged that respondent No. 1 who was her tenant in respect of the disputed house in Dhanmondi Residential Area fraudulently created an agreement for sale of the said house in her favour during the absence of the petitioner from Bangladesh and instituted a suit for specific performance of contract and obtained an exparte decree there in. Police upon investigation submitted charge-sheet under the aforesaid sections against the respondent and others.
